about_the_game:
GODSCALE is a 2D pixel art action roguelike platformer set in an ancient Egyptian tomb. Monsters overrun its halls, and only by facing a god can you prevent its ancient evil from breaking free. Explore perilous floors of the crypt filled with progressively tougher enemies, and carefully manage your blades, spells, items and artifacts.

Upgrade your blades at the forge and enhance abilities in the Book of the Dead. Collect Ankh tokens to unlock permanent upgrades. Be aware that items, spells, and artifacts found during each run vanish upon death. For each attempt, curses lurk in every shadow, changing how you fight and survive.

Face tactical decisions with two-sided scales, contend with curses, and navigate traps, merchants, and usable items that make every run unique.

Guard the crypt, face its evil, and claim the might of the gods

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce 400
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: GODSCALE is a 2D pixel art action roguelike set in an ancient Egyptian tomb. Face monsters, deadly traps, and powerful curses while managing blades, spells, and artifacts. Upgrade abilities in the Book of the Dead, collect Ankh tokens, and master the crypt to claim the gods' power.
